newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech state budget deficit CZK 2.7 bln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Czech state budget deficit CZK 2.7 bln - paper.

text.p: The state budget deficit totalled 2.7 billion crowns as of September 18, the leading Czech daily Mlada Fronta Dnes reported on Friday.

The paper quoted the figure from Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik, who added that the budget should be balanced at year's end. Finance ministry officials were not immediately available for comment on the report.

The government has passed a 1996 budget with both revenues and expenditures of 491.0 billion crowns. A balanced 1997 budget has also been approved, with forceast revenues and expenditures of 549.1 billion crowns. -- Prague Newsroom, 42-2-2423-0003
